summary: The technology coordinator of a public school district urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, rejecting proposals to sunset or eliminate it, and emphasizes the importance of reliable broadband for modern public education. The comment urges protection of E-Rate to ensure schools can maintain connectivity costs and provide students with reliable, affordable, and effective connectivity.

claims.argument: Reducing E-Rate would have direct and tangible impact on school budgets
claims.evidence_quote: In the next few years we have major upgrades due for both our wireless and wired systems that will require funding that will stretch our local Technology budget and would require prolonged usage of out of support devices. Those costs would ultimately compete with the resources we use to support students and educators.

claims.argument: Protecting E-Rate ensures schools can maintain connectivity costs
claims.evidence_quote: I urge the Commission to protect E-Rate and ensure that public schools can continue providing students with reliable, affordable, and effective connectivity.
